# gauzzaDocs plugin marketplace

<!-- Generated by `npm run marketplace` from plugins/*/plugin.json and plugins/external.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Install these in the app under Plugins > Marketplace, or from a terminal with `gdocs plugins install <id>`. Every
file is checked against the SHA-256 in [marketplace.json](marketplace.json) before it's installed.

To add your own, see [submitting a plugin](README.md#submitting-a-plugin) or [fill in the submission form](https://github.com/mattgauzza/gauzzaDocs/issues/new?template=plugin-submission.yml).

## Data

| | Plugin | Version | What it does | Works with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 📊 | [**CSV table preview**](csv-preview/) `csv-preview` | 1.0.0 | Shows CSV and TSV text as a table and lines up the columns. | csv |
| 📋 | [**Markdown tables**](markdown-tables/) `markdown-tables` | 1.0.0 | Turns CSV or a copied spreadsheet range into a Markdown table and back. | markdown, csv, text |
| 🔁 | [**JSON and YAML**](yaml-tools/) `yaml-tools` | 1.0.0 | Converts JSON to YAML and YAML to JSON and tidies YAML indentation. | json, yaml |

## Developer

| | Plugin | Version | What it does | Works with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 🧰 | [**Developer utilities**](dev-utils/) `dev-utils` | 1.0.0 | UUIDs, timestamps, lorem ipsum, SHA-256 hashes, JWT decoding and JSON string escaping. | any file |
| 📈 | [**Log insights**](log-insights/) `log-insights` | 1.0.0 | Shows counts by log level and the most common errors beside any log file. | text, json |

## Formatting

| 🧩 | [**JSON tools**](json-tools/) `json-tools` | 1.0.0 | Pretty print, minify and sort JSON, with a tree view. | json |
